breakdown.description: E_T = V_f E_f + V_m E_m; use 1/E_T = V_f/E_f + V_m/E_m; the setup labels the calculation as an inverse rule of mixtures problem but provides the direct longitudinal rule instead.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeated the exact error from the incomplete prompt. It explicitly states 'Use the inverse rule of mixtures as given: E_T = V_f E_f + V_m E_m' and proceeds to calculate using the direct (longitudinal) rule of mixtures formula, arriving at ~118.34 GPa. The ground truth requires using the correct inverse rule of mixtures formula: 1/E_T = V_f/E_f + V_m/E_m, which would yield a much lower transverse modulus (~16.4 GPa). The agent failed to correct the inconsistency and instead followed the flawed formula from the incomplete prompt.
